app.lema: Request, approve and buy without losing anything along the way.

arranque.despertando: Waking up the demo, this can take up to a minute.
arranque.noResponde: The server is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

lista.subtitulo: What you requested and where each one stands.
lista.vacioTexto: When you need material, create a requisition with its lines and send it for signature.
lista.errorTexto: The server returned an error. Your requisitions are safe.

nueva.totalNota: The final total is calculated by the server when saving.
nueva.firmasNota: Above $20,000 two signatures from different people are required.

errores.cantidad: Quantity must be a whole number greater than 0.
errores.repetido: That product is already in another line.

detalle.motivoError: To reject, write the reason: the requester will read it.
detalle.propia: You cannot approve or reject your own requisition.

errores.propia: You cannot approve or reject your own requisition.
errores.ya_decidio: You already recorded your decision on this requisition.
errores.transicion_invalida: The requisition changed state while you were viewing it. Reload the page.
errores.motivo_requerido: Write the reason for the rejection.
errores.producto_invalido: A product is no longer available from that supplier.
errores.proveedor_invalido: The supplier is no longer available.
errores.no_es_tuya: Only the requester can do this.
errores.duplicado: A record with that data already exists (for example, a repeated SKU).
errores.referencia: One of the related records no longer exists.
errores.permisos: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errores.no_encontrado: The record no longer exists. Reload the list.

compras.sinPermisos: This section is for Purchasing only
compras.sinPermisosTexto: Your role does not have access to this information.
compras.errorTexto: The server responded with an error. Your data is safe.
compras.vacioTexto: Records will appear here once there are some.

ordenes.subtitulo: They are created automatically when a requisition is approved.
ordenes.vacioTexto: Approve a requisition and its order will appear here in a few seconds.

avisos.subtitulo: What would have been sent to each supplier. Suppliers do not have an account.
avisos.vacioTexto: Every purchase order creates a notice for its supplier.

mensajes.ayuda: Messages are retried automatically up to 5 times. Failed ones have used all their attempts and need review.
mensajes.vacioTexto: Change the filter to see other messages.

catalogo.subtitulo: Suppliers and products that can be requested.
catalogo.vacioProveedoresTexto: Create the first one with the button above.
catalogo.vacioProductosTexto: Create one or change the supplier filter.

errores.sku: Only letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore.
errores.precio: Enter a price greater than 0 with at most 2 decimals.
